title: Signature Duo 11 · Glamour Hourglass × USSBBW · Dancheong × Celadon Sanggam · Palace Eaves
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, a dramatic contrast of an impossibly tiny waist and extreme soft volume.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — mid 30s, sleek center-parted low bun with a gold binyeo. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model. Body Art: Full body Korean dancheong body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. Glossy celadon green, vermilion, cobalt blue, and golden yellow in the style of palace eave painting, large layered lotus medallions and continuous cloud scrolls. The lotus medallions spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — late 30s, sleek high chignon with a jade binyeo. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms. Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze with fine crackle, densely inlaid with black-and-white sanggam lotus arabesques and flying cranes. The lotus arabesques cover the whole body, a black-and-white inlaid ribbon along each belly roll, darker glaze settling into each deep crease. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a wide stance with a strong hip shift, one hand resting lightly on her outer thigh, the other arm hanging relaxed away from the body. The right woman — standing full frontal with her feet planted far apart, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, never covering the belly, so every roll is fully visible.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high celadon platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: Beneath the eaves of a Korean royal palace hall, painted dancheong rafters and red columns softly out of focus, warm daylight glowing beyond, the background much lighter than their bodies, warm bounce light carving the impossibly tiny waist on the left and deep shadows between each belly roll on the right, making the materials gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
